description: A use child containing a tree loop -- dispatch events from inside the child are never namespaced under the use node, matching the child's own unnamespaced Store.concurrent_dispatch (review finding 3 on PR #472). The tree-dynamic half of this probe is a Rust test instead (electricity-vm/tests/use_effect.rs): a dynamic container's own meta.adapter also picks up the use-triggered real-adapter heuristic, which this harness's single-location known_divergence can't express alongside the root's own.
